digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows for main-branch CI on Gerrit mirror
propositions: Commits pushed to main trigger CI runs that cancel predecessors, causing red X marks on a healthy main branch even though Gerrit's per-patchset gate passed
GitHub Actions cannot natively suppress cancelled-run check marks; the only structural fix is to move main-branch CI from push triggers to scheduled execution

Six workflows currently trigger on push to main (test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, terraform-drift.yml) and must be reconfigured to drop main from their triggers while preserving non-main branch CI
Scheduled main-health runs must publish the last-known-green SHA and a git bisect recipe to aid rapid remediation when a multi-commit batch fails
Non-main push CI, Gerrit pre-merge gating (gerrit-verify.yaml), reconciler workflows, and external-integration.yml remain unchanged by this policy shift
